requirements.section_description: Permanent generation rules. Keep these requirements unchanged when preparing new Tamil-themed image or video prompts.
requirements.purpose: Create culturally authentic, visually coherent Tamil-themed images and short videos.
requirements.language: English prompt instructions; preserve any Tamil dialogue or text exactly as supplied.
cultural_authenticity: Represent the specified Tamil Nadu region, era, occasion, customs, clothing, architecture, food, and objects accurately.
Do not mix unrelated regional Indian traditions or use generic South Asian styling.
When a ritual or cultural detail is uncertain, do not invent it; use only details explicitly supplied or well-established for the stated context.
visual_quality: Use realistic anatomy, natural facial expressions, believable hands, and detailed materials.
Maintain coherent perspective, lighting, shadows, scale, and environmental details.
Avoid artificial-looking skin, excessive retouching, oversaturation, and unnecessary visual effects.
continuity: For videos or multiple frames, preserve each character's identity, age appearance, hairstyle, clothing, jewellery, and props.
Maintain consistency in location, era, time of day, weather, lighting, and colour treatment.
Use natural, physically plausible movement and smooth camera motion.
text_and_branding: Do not add captions, subtitles, logos, signatures, or watermarks unless explicitly requested.
Render Tamil text only when exact wording is provided; preserve spelling and script.
generation_method: Treat the editable template as the creative brief for the current generation.
Generate only the media type selected in the template.
Change only the relevant template fields for each new generation; keep these requirements unchanged.
Use sensible defaults for optional blank fields without inventing specific cultural practices.
global_negative_prompt: unrequested text, captions, logos, or watermarks

template.section_description: Editable fields for one image or video generation. Replace these values for the next creative task; retain the field structure unless the task requires a change.

subject.description: Describe the main person, people, object, or scene.
subject.age_or_group: Specify the age group or type of people, if relevant.
subject.appearance: Describe visible appearance, hairstyle, and other relevant details.
subject.expression_or_mood: Describe the intended expression or emotional tone.
subject.pose_or_action: Describe the subject's pose or action.

setting.location: Specify the exact Tamil Nadu location or type of setting.
setting.era: Specify the historical period or contemporary era.
setting.time_of_day: Specify dawn, morning, afternoon, golden hour, evening, or night.
background_details: List relevant architecture, landscape, decor, and environmental details.

cultural_authenticity.region_or_tradition: Specify the Tamil region or tradition.
cultural_authenticity.occasion: Specify the festival, ceremony, family event, or everyday context.
cultural_authenticity.clothing: Specify attire, fabric, colours, and draping.
cultural_authenticity.jewellery_and_accessories: Specify relevant jewellery, flowers, and accessories.
cultural_authenticity.architecture_and_props: Specify buildings, utensils, furniture, tools, and props.
cultural_authenticity.food_and_floral_details: Specify dishes, serving style, flowers, and kolam, if relevant.
cultural_authenticity.additional_authenticity_notes: Add any important cultural details or restrictions for this scene.

camera.camera_movement: Static for images; specify movement for videos.

composition.safe_margins: Keep important subjects and details within the frame.

continuity.identity_consistency: Specify identity and appearance details to preserve.
continuity.scene_consistency: Specify location, background, time, and lighting details to preserve.
continuity.motion_consistency: Specify natural movement requirements for video.

timeline.visual_action: Establish the setting and introduce the subject.
Show the main action with subtle, natural movement.
End with a clear, visually pleasing composition.

audio.ambience: Specify location-appropriate ambient sound, if required.
audio.music: Specify original instrumental music, if required.

video.transition: Natural continuity with no unnecessary cuts.

additional_negative_prompt: Add scene-specific elements to avoid here.

generation_instructions.instruction: Generate the selected media type using the editable template while following all permanent requirements.
generation_instructions.edit_strategy: For each new generation, update only the relevant template values. Keep the requirements section unchanged.
generation_instructions.empty_field_policy: Use sensible defaults for optional blank fields. Do not invent exact dialogue, text, rituals, or historical details.
